reason: A web UI attachment plugin that adds categorized image and file uploads, storing non-image attachments in the conversation workspace for model-assisted file access.

summaries.zh: 为对话输入框增加图片、文档和其他文件的分类上传功能，并将非图片附件保存到会话工作区。
summaries.en: Adds categorized image, document, and file uploads to the conversation input, saving non-image attachments into the session workspace.

capabilities: Adds categorized image, document, and file upload controls to a web conversation input
Uses a host API to write uploaded non-image files into the session workspace uploads directory
Invokes a host shell operation to create the upload directory and write decoded file contents
